upstream: UPSTREAM: Lewis AL, Young GJ, et al. urodynamics versus routine noninvasive tests before surgery for male LUTS (Eur Urol 2020; NIHR HTA 2020)
reactt: REACTT: Montorsi F, et al. tadalafil once daily or on demand after nerve-sparing radical prostatectomy (Eur Urol 2014)
merit: MERIT: Hayward G, et al. D-mannose for prevention of recurrent UTI in women (JAMA Intern Med 2024)
vue: VUE: Hemming C, et al. the two VUE RCTs: uterine-preserving surgery versus vaginal hysterectomy for uterine prolapse, and vault prolapse procedures (NIHR HTA 2020 and journal reports)

steenkamp-dilation: Steenkamp JW, Heyns CF, de Kock ML. internal urethrotomy versus dilation for male urethral stricture, prospective randomized comparison (J Urol 1997)
